records.note_text: Met with the Amazon treasury team to discuss the relationship and upcoming service renewals. The client expressed continued dissatisfaction with implementation delays and indicated that a competing bank is being considered for a larger share of its treasury activity. Annual relationship revenue is down approximately 20% year over year, and several expansion discussions remain stalled. I am formally flagging the Amazon relationship as at risk. Immediate executive outreach and a documented service-recovery plan are recommended before the next client review.

During the latest relationship review, Exxon Mobil raised concerns about pricing, responsiveness, and unresolved operational issues. The client is evaluating alternative providers for portions of its payments and liquidity-management activity. Relationship revenue has declined by approximately 18% year over year, and recent transaction activity has weakened. I consider the Exxon Mobil relationship currently at risk and recommend escalating the service issues to the executive sponsor within two weeks.

Spoke with Alphabet's finance team following a decline in transaction volumes and relationship revenue. The client reported that a competitor has proposed more favorable pricing and broader integration support. Alphabet has postponed two planned product-expansion discussions and has not committed to the proposed remediation meeting. With relationship revenue down approximately 22% year over year and competitive pressure increasing, I am explicitly flagging this relationship as at risk. Priority actions are executive engagement, revised pricing, and confirmation of a recovery plan before the next quarterly review.
Amazon reported acceptable service levels, although pricing pressure was increasing. The relationship remained stable and was not flagged at risk.
The payments migration schedule is at risk because of integration delays, but Amazon confirmed that the overall banking relationship remains stable.

Amazon shifted part of its treasury activity to a competitor and deferred two expansion opportunities. Given the wallet-share loss and unresolved service complaints, I now view the relationship as at risk of further attrition.

Executive outreach was constructive, but Amazon has not restored the transaction volumes moved to the competitor. The relationship remains at risk pending agreement on pricing and a service-recovery timetable.
Walmart reported strong satisfaction with payments performance and asked to explore additional liquidity services. The relationship is healthy.
A holiday-volume capacity issue created operational risk for the payments program. The incident was contained, and the overall Walmart relationship is not at risk.
Walmart approved a pilot for expanded liquidity management. Client sentiment remains positive, and no relationship-level concerns were identified.
A senior contact warned that unresolved reporting defects could put the relationship at risk if they continued. The defects have since been corrected.
Walmart confirmed that reporting remediation is complete and removed the earlier escalation. The relationship is strong and is not currently at risk.
Apple praised the global payments rollout and requested a proposal for additional foreign-exchange services. Relationship momentum is strong.
A data-mapping dependency puts the January implementation milestone at risk. Apple emphasized that this is a project issue and does not threaten the broader relationship.
Apple accepted the revised implementation schedule and expanded the scope of the FX discussion. Client sentiment is positive.
Apple asked for improved pricing and mentioned a competing quote. This is normal procurement activity; I do not consider the relationship at risk.
Apple renewed the core payments mandate and agreed to begin the FX pilot. The relationship remains strong.
UnitedHealth Group is satisfied with treasury services and is evaluating a liquidity-management proposal. The relationship is stable.
The client escalated two reconciliation errors and requested faster issue ownership. Sentiment is mixed, but no intention to reduce the relationship was indicated.
Reconciliation remediation is complete, and the client acknowledged improved responsiveness. The relationship is recovering and is not flagged at risk.
UnitedHealth Group advanced the liquidity proposal to due diligence. The client remains cautious on price but constructive on expansion.
The client sponsor confirmed satisfaction with remediation and scheduled a final workshop. The relationship is stable and presents a developing opportunity.
CVS Health reported steady service performance and no material relationship concerns. The client is open to payments optimization.
A competitor offered aggressive pricing for a limited payments scope. CVS described it as benchmarking and did not signal an intention to move the broader relationship.
The payments optimization workshop identified savings opportunities. Client engagement is constructive, although approval timing remains uncertain.
CVS delayed a product decision due to budget review. The opportunity is at risk of slipping, but the overall relationship remains stable.
CVS resumed the product review and reaffirmed its core services. I see no current relationship-level risk flag.
Exxon Mobil described service as reliable and agreed to review a trade-finance proposal. The relationship is stable.
The trade-finance implementation timeline is at risk due to documentation delays. Exxon clarified that the concern is limited to the project and the overall relationship remains stable.
Exxon Mobil escalated recurring operational failures and began benchmarking competitors. The relationship is now at risk unless reliability improves quickly.
Operational metrics improved slightly, but Exxon continues its competitor review. I am maintaining the relationship at-risk flag until stability is demonstrated for a full quarter.
Alphabet is reviewing product utilization after a modest volume decline. The client remains engaged, and I do not consider the relationship at risk.
An integration milestone is at risk of missing the quarter. Alphabet stated that this project delay does not affect the overall banking relationship.
Alphabet moved transaction volume to a competitor and declined an expansion meeting. I am flagging the relationship as at risk because of continuing wallet-share erosion.
Alphabet attended remediation but has not committed to restore volume. The relationship remains at risk, with pricing and integration support as principal concerns.
McKesson reported consistent service and interest in expanded liquidity management. The relationship is stable.
The client raised a reporting defect affecting one unit. McKesson expects remediation but expressed no broader relationship concern.
The reporting defect was resolved and McKesson accepted the liquidity pilot design. Sentiment has returned to positive.
A resourcing constraint puts the pilot launch date at risk, but McKesson reaffirmed confidence in the broader relationship.
McKesson approved the revised pilot schedule and requested executive planning. The relationship remains stable and is not at risk.
Cencora is satisfied with core treasury services and wants to evaluate trade finance. The relationship is developing positively.
Cencora challenged pricing and shared a competitor benchmark. The discussion was constructive, with no indication that the relationship is at risk.
Cencora accepted a revised pricing framework and scheduled a trade-finance workshop. Client sentiment is positive.
Legal review puts the trade-finance opportunity at risk of delay. The client emphasized that its existing relationship remains stable.
Cencora completed legal review and plans to proceed to a pilot. The relationship is stable with expansion potential.
Costco described core payments as reliable and requested ideas for liquidity visibility. Engagement remains constructive.
Costco raised concerns about fee transparency and requested a pricing review. The client remains committed to current services, so the relationship is not at risk.
Costco accepted revised fee disclosure and agreed to a liquidity-management discovery session. Sentiment is neutral to positive.
The discovery timeline is at risk because Costco is reallocating resources. This delay applies to the opportunity, not the overall relationship.
Costco rescheduled discovery and reaffirmed satisfaction with core payments. The relationship remains stable with no current at-risk designation.
